# Contributing

Read docs/development/BRANCHING.md, architecture, evaluation and deployment docs. Keep changes on a focused work branch and show actual tests/evidence. Preserve original data and the independent deterministic comparator. Never include credentials/private data or describe scripted/local evidence as live model quality or monitored cloud operation. Add meaningful adversarial, recovery or semantic checks when changing authority boundaries. Run hashed backend tests and frontend build/audit; container/restart CI is required before merging.
